shortfall_policy: Select all available cases when a stratum is smaller than its quota. Do not reallocate unused quota to another stratum.
sampling_method: Text: balance the fixed stratum quota across confusion cells, then select seed-ranked cases within each cell without replacement. Images: review all 100 held-out cases per description condition. Independently seed-rank review order and A/B identity.
interpretation: Automated reviewer judgments are evidence about the selected cases, not human truth or an unweighted estimate of population correctness. Report actual eligible/selected/reviewed counts by stratum.
